label: GO
call: Launch B behind a paid gate: make production work, hand-sell a EUR 49 tested-decision report to 20 founders over three weeks, and open the public German page only if at least 8 of 20 pay.

why.point: A decision is occasional, so sell a EUR 49 report, not a EUR 29 subscription.
A paid gate tests price and sharing at once; a free beta tests neither price nor love properly.
Nothing counts until production works and real reports exist.
The shared report is the only leverage, so keep the link free and measure it.
Broad paid ads give a CAC near EUR 400 against about EUR 270 lifetime profit.

minority.quote: Sharing is the one signal of product love here, so a pass on that signal shouldn't come cheaper than a pass on payment.
minority.would_have_to_be_true: Buyers pay out of politeness to a founder they know, so only sharing shows real love.

next_steps.action: Production live, 10 real council sessions, euro cost logged, reports read aloud.
20 named founders, EUR 49 checkout, revenue-linked cap, shared-link tracking.
Gate decision: public German page, second gate, or Option D.

kill_criteria: Fewer than 8 of 20 pay, fewer than 5 share, or refunds above 25% at the gate; under 40 paying buyers by day 90 after the public page.
conditions: Production works and a session costs EUR 1.50 or less by 2026-11-15
Cap = EUR 50 plus 20% of last month's revenue, trial reserve separate, before any public link
Gate: at least 8 of 20 pay, refunds at most 25%, at least 5 paying buyers share, at least 1 sign-up per 20 link views
Founder hours at most 10 a week; gate stretches to 5 weeks if exceeded
English only after the gate passes

fights.story: Graham, Martell and Elon wanted a 30-day closed beta, Bezos, Buffett and Naval one to two weeks; Hormozi's paid pilot settled it at three weeks with 20 paying outsiders.
Six seats wanted three, Graham, Sara and Elon one; resolved as one during the gate and three on the public page.
Buffett showed the EUR 50 cap also covers payers; everyone tied it to revenue, Bezos's EUR 50 plus 20% replaced the larger-of rule.

amendments.amendment: Cap = EUR 50 plus 20% of last month's revenue.
amendments.reason: The larger-of rule gives no headroom below EUR 250; unanswered.

amendments.amendment: Only the business decision council during the gate; 6 or 7 of 20 is a fail.

amendments.reason: Gary V asked the same; no objection.

amendments.reason: Counting only payers adopted; the bar stays 5 because 20 sales are too few to judge on shares (Hormozi).
